title: {org} customer portal

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.description: Enter the email {org} has on file for you, and we'll send you a link to sign in. No password needed.
signIn.sent: If {email} is on file with {org}, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once, for 15 minutes.
signIn.demoDescription: One click, no email: sign in as {name}, a fictional customer of {org}.

auth.title: Sign in to {org}
auth.description: Continue to request service and follow your jobs.
auth.missing: This sign-in link is incomplete. Ask for a new one.

home.description: Request service and follow your jobs with {org}.
home.emptyHint: Something not working? Request service and we'll get back to you.

request.title: Request service
request.description: Tell us what's wrong and when suits you. {org} will confirm the exact time.
request.whatHint: For example: which unit, what it does, since when.
request.whenHint: Pick up to three. We'll confirm the exact time.
request.photosHint: Up to 3 photos (JPEG, PNG or WebP, 5 MB each).
request.uploadFailed: A photo couldn't be uploaded. Try again.
request.wrongType: {name} isn't a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo.
